| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| `/lp-land <tiles>` | Lands a faction base east of you (default 60). |
| `/lp-trace` | Toggle writing the planner's decisions to script-output/landing-party/decisions.txt. |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Developer tools (admins only)

`/lp` forces what the mod otherwise times and rolls for. It is for testing, and it spoils a game. Corporation names are the internal ones: `serenity` for Kessler-Hayashi, `grubstake` for Grubstake.

`/lp list | raid | siege | strip | strike | perimeter [id] | land <corp> [tiles] [now] | parts <n> [id] | fast | grudge [id] | burst [big] | tesla [n] | spread | ranks | provoke | era <n> | trace`

Further verbs: `incidents`, `biotech` (Synthexis lands now), `wave` (Synthexis sends a wave now), `rig`, `tap`.

`burst` sets off a Synthexis burster east of you (`big` for a big burster): its wind-up and its blast, which is real. `spread` and `ranks` make Synthexis's next siege a spread assault or a siege in ranks; `wave` sends it.
:::
